page_title: MET 0-1 TOU | Metz v Toulouse 14/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Van Den Kerkhof K. International duty

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+3' Toulouse take a short corner kick.
90+3' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) inside the box. The referee blows his whistle, Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Metz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Here comes a substitution. Jean N'Guessan (Metz) is given a rest as he is replaced by Arthur Atta.
88' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alexandre Oukidja with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
87' A rebound sits up perfectly for Maxime Colin (Metz), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post.
85' CHANCE! Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) receives a brilliant pass and finds himself one-on-one with Alexandre Oukidja, who reacts superbly to stop him.
81' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
79' The substitution is prepared. Yann Gboho (Toulouse) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Cesar Gelabert Pina.
79' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

78' Guillaume Restes makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Georges Mikautadze (Metz) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the left side of the target. The ball goes behind for a corner. Metz will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
78' Ismael Traore (Metz) climbs higher than the defenders inside the box and plants a towering header against the crossbar. What a great chance!
77' Laszlo Boloni has decided to make a change. Pape Diallo (Metz) replaces Cheikh Sabaly.
76' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is penalised for holding. Florent Batta signals a set piece. Metz win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
72' Christophe Herelle (Metz) takes out his opponent with a nasty slide tackle and receives a straight red card from the referee!
69' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
68' A brilliant individual effort! Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post.
66' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Joel Asoro walks off the pitch to be replaced by Benjamin Tetteh (Metz).
64' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
63' The free kick from close range, taken by Metz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' One of the Toulouse players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Metz earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
61' Joel Asoro (Metz) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
60' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
60' The free kick from long range, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
57' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Metz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

53' Ismael Traore (Metz) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
51' Maxime Colin (Metz) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
51' A cross from Matthieu Udol (Metz) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
49' Joel Asoro (Metz) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
48' Florent Batta blows the whistle, Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) is penalised for a foul.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Jean N'Guessan (Metz) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Guillaume Restes has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
40' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
40' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
37' Today's referee Florent Batta rightly decides to book Kevin N'Doram (Metz) for his harsh tackle.
35' Kevin N'Doram (Metz) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
32' Laszlo Boloni isn't happy on the touchline after referee Florent Batta shows him a yellow card.
31' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Metz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' The rebound finds Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) in space inside the box, but his shot goes well wide of the left post. That was a promising chance!
28' Metz have a corner.
28' Matthieu Udol (Metz) strikes a volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
27' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:1.
23' Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
20' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
18' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Florent Batta didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
15' A cross from a corner kick by Toulouse is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
12' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Alexandre Oukidja no chance!
11' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is going to take the penalty!
10' A player from Metz pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Toulouse are given a penalty!
6' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
3' A pass by Joel Asoro (Metz) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Metz will have the kick-off.
Florent Batta will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
